verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no documented, downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec for Cal.com's API, and a probe found every common spec path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returning 404. Schema-like YAML snippets inside individual endpoint doc pages, llms.txt, and markdown docs are adjacent machine-readable documentation, not a downloadable API spec, so they earn no credit.
